meta.name: design-critique
meta.description: Use to give structured feedback on a screen, flow, or mockup — first impression, hierarchy, usability, consistency, accessibility, and what to fix first.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给屏幕或模型提供结构化设计反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要评估设计稿的可访问性和一致性
copy.tagline_en: Give structured feedback on screens, flows, or mockups
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to evaluate design mockups for accessibility and consistency

howto.what: Claude 会对屏幕、流程或原型进行结构化设计评审，覆盖第一印象、层次、可用性、一致性、可访问性等维度，并输出总体印象、发现列表、亮点及前三项改进建议。
howto.when: 当用户上传或描述界面设计（如截图、原型），或要求对设计提供反馈时触发。

say.text: 请对我的登录页面进行设计评审。
say.note: Claude 会按五个维度给出结构化反馈。

say.text: 检查这个原型的一致性。
say.note: Claude 会指出与设计系统的偏差。

say.text: 这个界面在可访问性上有什么问题？
say.note: Claude 会检查色彩对比度、触控目标等。

howto.what_en: Claude performs a structured design critique on screens, flows, or mockups, covering first impression, hierarchy, usability, consistency, and accessibility, then outputs an overall impression, grouped findings, what works, and top three changes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user uploads or describes a UI design (e.g., screenshot, mockup) or requests design feedback.

say_en.note: Claude gives structured feedback across five passes.
Claude names deviations from the design system.

say_en.text: What accessibility issues does this screen have?
say_en.note: Claude checks contrast, touch targets, etc.
